title: handleSubmitForApproval calls `loadMsa()` — function is not defined in the component scope
detail: Line 83: `loadMsa();` — but there's no function named loadMsa defined anywhere in the file. Calling loadMsa() will throw ReferenceError at runtime.
evidence: MsaDetail.jsx:83 `loadMsa();` — grep 'function loadMsa' or 'const loadMsa' in this file returns zero hits.
recommendedFix: Extract the load logic into a useCallback named loadMsa, or replace line 83 with a re-fetch inline.

title: MsaDetail destructures `isAdmin, isManager` but never uses them
detail: Line 28: `const { user, isAdmin, isManager } = usePortalUser();` — isAdmin and isManager are destructured but never referenced.
evidence: MsaDetail.jsx:28 destructure; no other references to isAdmin/isManager in the file.
recommendedFix: Decide per business rule: are MSA edit/generate actions restricted to admins? If YES, wrap the buttons. If NO, drop the unused destructure.

title: DocumentHistory useEffect has no error handler on the apiGet
detail: Line 243-245: `apiGet(...).then(r => setDocs(r?.value ?? []));` — no .catch, so any failure produces an unhandled promise rejection.
recommendedFix: Add `.catch(() => setDocs([]))` or surface the error to a toast/banner.

title: MsaDetail handleSaveEdit has no try/catch — apiPatch failure is unhandled
detail: Lines 95-108: handleSaveEdit calls apiPatch then apiGet to refresh, with no try/catch. If the PATCH fails, the error is unhandled.
evidence: MsaDetail.jsx:95-108 — async function with no try/catch or .catch.
recommendedFix: Wrap in try/catch. On error: `toast.show('err', 'Failed to save: ' + e.message)`.

title: Generate MSA button not disabled after generation completes — no success feedback
detail: Lines 64-80: handleGenerate sets generating=true but after success, there is no toast or success banner. The user clicks 'Generate MSA', sees 'Generating...' briefly, then the button reverts with no visible confirmation.
recommendedFix: Add `toast.show('ok', 'MSA document generated')` after the re-fetch on line 75.

title: DocumentHistory apiGet has no $select — fetches all columns from dcfg_document_outputs
detail: Line 249: `apiGet('/dcfg_document_outputs?$filter=...')` has no `$select` clause. The component only uses 5 columns but fetches all.
evidence: MsaDetail.jsx:249 — apiGet with $filter and $orderby but no $select.

title: MsaDetail initial load fetches dcfg_document_url but MSA documents use dcfg_output_file_url
detail: Line 49: the initial apiGet includes `dcfg_document_url` in $select. Line 145 renders a link from it. But DocumentHistory at line 268 uses dcfg_output_file_url from dcfg_document_outputs. These are two different columns on two different tables — the MSA-level URL may not be populated by V4 OOXML docgen.
evidence: MsaDetail.jsx:49 — `dcfg_document_url` in $select. Line 268 — dcfg_output_file_url from different table.
recommendedFix: Verify whether dcfg_document_url is still populated by V4 docgen. If not, the 'View Document' link should read from the latest dcfg_document_outputs row.
